trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks itself once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task to chase. Treat it as the finish line of this desk: work the roadmap in order, keep the counters moving, and check the missables page before you pass any point the official descriptions flag. When the counter at the top reads 54 of 55, one trophy is still open — use the Next up planner to find it. This is a gold trophy in its own right and one of the last two to fall, because 100% completion covers the story, the stranger strands, the activities and the collectibles together. trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts are the game's driving and riding tricks — jumps, near misses and the like — and they add up over normal play, so this is a long grind best left running in the background while you do everything else. The counter on this trophy tracks your progress toward 250. trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. One taste of each is enough. trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges appear as you fish around Leonida, and Cal is the named rival for this one. trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missable_reason: The description needs a 4-star wanted level lost 'with your partner' — a specific situation that has to be set up and may not come up again in the same way, so treat it as possibly missable and plan it deliberately.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat dies down. Plan it on purpose rather than waiting for it to happen — you need your partner beside you when the stars fall. trophies.missable_reason: The description needs 3 shops robbed 'back-to-back' without losing the wanted level — one failed robbery or a lost wanted level breaks the chain, so treat the run as possibly missable and plan it in one clean attempt.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Pick three shops close together, rob them one after another with your partner, and keep the wanted level alive the whole way — if the heat drops or a robbery fails, the chain breaks and the run has to start over. trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan a quiet approach: go in unseen, take what the robbery asks for, and get out before anyone spots you. trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — all 9 gangs. Illegal operations are gang-run spots in the world, and each gang needs one of theirs hit. Work through the gangs one by one and use the counter to see which of the 9 are still untouched. Sources: the official trophy list on Exophase for its name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target; our own advice drawn only from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, find a place to order a cocktail, and take it in with the view. It is a quiet moment of a trophy — no combat, no chase, just the drink and the beach. Sources: the official trophy list on Exophase for its name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for PSN's count where it has one; our own advice drawn only from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Go to a vehicle showroom, get into a vehicle inside it and drive straight out through the glass. The trophy wants the dramatic exit, not a polite one. trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and play through a game, following through on your throws. One visit and a finished game is what the description asks for. trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague — it points at a moment with your partner that draws a crowd. Play the story and the partner activities and watch for the moment the game stages; the official description gives no location or step to follow. Sources: the official trophy list on Exophase for its name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for PSN's count where it has one; our own advice drawn only from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable_reason: The description is 'Choices made (for better or worse)' and PSN tracks a count to 500 — choices in the story may lock in outcomes, so some choices may not be repeatable in the same playthrough. Treat it as possibly missable and think before each big choice.
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Story choices add up — PSN tracks them toward 500 — so keep choosing whenever the game offers a decision instead of leaving choices unmade. The counter tracks your progress toward 500, and the count is what matters, not whether any single choice was right. Sources: the official trophy list on Exophase for its name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target; our own advice drawn only from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missable_reason: The description is 'Second time's the charm' — it suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something, which may only be possible if the first attempt fails. Treat it as possibly missable and do not assume it can be forced.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This trophy is about succeeding on a second attempt — something you tried once, failed, and then got right. The official description gives no activity or location, so play normally, and when something fails, go back and try it again rather than moving on. Sources: the official trophy list on Exophase for its name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for PSN's count where it has one; our own advice drawn only from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? This trophy is for witnessing something strange in Leonida — one of the game's odd, unscripted moments. Keep your eyes open as you explore, especially in out-of-the-way places, and the moment will find you. trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving, strike someone with a melee attack from the vehicle — a drive-by done with a melee weapon rather than a gun. It needs a target close enough to reach from the car, so try it on a quiet road with someone nearby. trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money that has to be cleaned through contacts, and a quarter of a million dollars of it must be laundered. Keep laundering as the bills come in and use the counter to watch the total climb toward $250,000. Sources: the official trophy list on Exophase for its name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target; our own advice drawn only from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Shopping counts toward it — clothes, food, gear, anything bought in a shop — so the total grows with normal spending across the game. Use the counter to see how much of the $100,000 is spent, and top it up with big purchases if you are close. Sources: the official trophy list on Exophase for its name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target; our own advice drawn only from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — all 8 of them. Garages are bought around Leonida and give you somewhere to keep vehicles. Save up, buy them one at a time and use the counter to see how many of the 8 are yours. Sources: the official trophy list on Exophase for its name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target; our own advice drawn only from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles in the world and register them through the Scooter Bros app until ten are on the books. Any ten vehicles count, so register as you discover them and let the counter show how many of the 10 are done.
